sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Pontiac Lake Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483528, maps 'East Loop', 'West Loop': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-20, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site: 20/30-amp sites $30 weeknights, $33 Saturday; 50-amp sites $35 / $38 (probed 2027-05-20, 07-13 and Sat 07-17). 2026: $28 (20/30-amp) and $33 (50-amp) in the DNR rates table. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Pontiac Lake Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483528, maps 'East Loop', 'West Loop': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-20, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17) (East/West Loop campsites on fee schedules -32471: 30 on 2027-05-20 and 2027-07-13, 33 on Sat 2027-07-17; -31535 (50-amp): 35, 35, 38) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Pontiac Lake / East and West Loops: Modern camping 50 AMP $33, 20/30 AMP $28) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/pontiaclake ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/pontiaclake (Modern Campground: 'There is 20- and 30-amp service available at most sites'; tag 'Some campsites with 50-amp service') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Pontiac Lake Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483528, maps 'East Loop', 'West Loop': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-20, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17) (52 East/West Loop sites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps', the rest 20/30 amp; 'Sewer Hookup=No' at every site), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 176 sites on the DNR page; the booking site lists 169 East and West Loop campsites plus 5 more. Allowed trailer/RV length is 40-45 ft at about 100 of them (one West Loop site 50 ft) and 30-35 ft at most others; 11 stop at 20-25 ft. No pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/pontiaclake (Pontiac Lake Modern Campground: 'Number of sites: 176') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Pontiac Lake Recreation Area, resourceLocationId -2147483528, maps 'East Loop', 'West Loop': /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-20, 2027-07-13, 2027-07-17) (East Loop 75, West Loop 94, unmapped 5 campsites; allowed equipment max 'Trailer or RV up to N'': West 20 ft x9, 25 x1, 30 x19, 35 x19, 40 x21, 45 x24, 50 x1; East 20 x1, 25 x1, 30 x9, 35 x11, 40 x29, 45 x24; no site 'Pull Through=Yes'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Sanitation station with potable water near the campground office, closed to non-campers; it is being rebuilt during the 2026 closure.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/pontiaclake (Modern Campground tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet', 'Sanitation station'; 'A sanitation station with potable water is located near the campground office. Due to capacity issues with the septic system, the Seven Lakes and Pontiac Lake sanitation stations are closed to non-campers'; 'construction on our new sanitation station and solar project'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757. The 2026 DNR rates table gave a Sept 1 - Oct 31 reservation season with 'Construction in 2026 will impact reservable dates'; the campground is closed for the rest of 2026.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/pontiaclake (Pontiac Lake Modern Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Pontiac Lake / East and West Loops: reservation season 'September 1' - 'October 31', 'Construction in 2026 will impact reservable dates.'), read 2026-10-25

note: Modern campground of Pontiac Lake Recreation Area: East and West loops at 3480 Teggerdine Road, White Lake, with sites from open and sunny to wooded and shady. The day-use beach, boat launch and fishing pier are 2 miles away off Williams Lake Road. The park's separate 25-site equestrian campground is not this entry. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + rates table + MiDNRReservations: closure confirmed (closed for the rest of 2026, reopens next season; manual status left as is). 176 sites, 50-amp (confirmed), max 50 ft at one site (most 30-45; confirmed), no pull-throughs, no sewer, showers, vault toilets, sanitation station (new), reservable on MiDNRReservations / 800-447-2757. Fees changed 28/33 (2026) -> 30/38 (2027 booking site: 20/30-amp $30 weeknight to 50-amp $38 Saturday). Pin is on the modern campground (OSM 'Pontiac Lake Recreation Area Modern Campground' ~120 m away), not the 25-site equestrian camp. No season statement; the 2026 reservation dates are construction-distorted, so booking.season left absent. Phone matches. Note trimmed (closure moved to status, field restatements dropped).
